text:
I bow down to the Victorious Ones.

I prostrate to you. You are the Virtuous Mother of all the Victorious Ones <note>original: "rgyal ba", referring to the Buddhas</note> of the past, the future, and the present. You are the Goddess, the Daughter of the Victorious Ones. You possess a nature that is without inherent nature. I shall speak the name of that Virtuous One who has become the Mother of the Buddhas. Let those who desire prosperity listen.

The Perfection of Wisdom <note>original: "shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa", Sanskrit: Prajnaparamita</note>, and All-Knowingness <note>original: "thams cad mkhyen pa nyid", Sanskrit: Sarvajñatā</note>, and the Knowledge of all aspects of the path <note>original: "lam gyi rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa", Sanskrit: Mārgākārajñatā</note> <unclear>rest of line not transcribed</unclear>

<summary>This page contains a devotional opening and praise to the Mother of all Buddhas, identifying her with the Perfection of Wisdom. It introduces the technical categories of Buddhist omniscience and the paths to enlightenment.</summary>
<keywords>Victorious Ones, Buddhas, Mother of Buddhas, Perfection of Wisdom, Prajnaparamita, All-Knowingness, Path Knowledge, Goddess</keywords>
